translations.english: Then the Rakshasa army appeared terrific, fixed with flags and poles, equipped with best of axes, horses yoked to formidable chariots and elephants different kinds of foot soldiers, distinguished by wielding shining tridents, maces, swords spears and lances warriors of frightening valour and prowess holding shining barbed missiles hundreds of tiny bells tied to the chariots and elephants making noise warriors endowed with arms decorated with gold, with axes and weapons to pierce arrows fixed to the bows, with an abundance of fragrance.
translations.hindi: उस गदा के लगने से कपिश्रेष्ठ ऋषभ की छाती विदीण हो गई । उसका शरीर काँप उठा और छाती से अहुत सा रक निकल गया
